podcast.title: CR-78 Modifications
podcast.body: As Ultravox's Canadian drummer, Warren Cann was fascinated by rhythm and the new possibilities offered by the Roland CR-78. He experimented by opening the machine and modifying its voltage regulators to prevent tempo drift from its sensitive control knob and to create a fatter bass drum sound, which can be heard on Ultravox's *Vienna* album. "So Warren opened it up and started playing with voltage regulators. He jury rigged away to keep tempo tight, as well as a way to make the bass drum sound fatter."
